title: Design System: Axiom 数学研究平台

sources.purpose: Effective cascade, approved product override and mobile reader fix.
Approved product constraints and identity commitment.
Approved canon direction and implementation surface brief.
User-approved library and reader organization reference.

display.purpose: Fluid home heading; effective mobile override is 30px/1.4.

headline.purpose: Module heading; mobile override is 28px. Administrator heading is 32px/1.4, mobile 28px.

title.purpose: Section and stage titles; book and document titles retain their content-specific sizes.

body.purpose: 16px baseline; long introductions often use 1.8 line-height and 65ch/75ch limits.

label.purpose: 14px baseline, preserving readable controls and metadata.

math.purpose: Mathematical notation only; PDF retains source document typography.

focus.name: composer
focus.purpose: Focus-within on integrated AI input; textarea outline is delegated to the surrounding frame.

focus.name: reader-drag
focus.purpose: Visible drag handle only on hover, focus or active dragging.

motion.name: document-scroll
motion.purpose: Existing page scrolling; reduced-motion changes it to auto.

motion.name: morphicons
motion.purpose: Preserve incumbent hover/focus morph interaction and its reduced-motion behavior; no new timing system.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Respect existing reduction preferences for scrolling and Morphicons.

responsive.application: 216px fixed desktop navigation, 64px topbar and max-width 1280px content; horizontal navigation at 900px; mobile content gutters 20px at 650px.
responsive.administrator: 216px desktop rail; max-width 1700px content; edit/list columns become one at 800px.
responsive.reader: Desktop grid minmax(0,1fr) 6px var(--reader-notes-width,380px); desktop drag geometry unchanged. Mobile preferred initial notes width 184px, bounded by available width and persisted preferences. Default closed outline. Right panel spans full height, notes default 35% with existing vertical drag.
responsive.aiHeader: At 650px wrap header, move actions to a full-width row and make provider select 92px; no control removal.
responsive.composer: Two actions remain a vertical column at right. Below 200px container width, action column is 48px and gap 4px.
responsive.markers: 30 columns of 28px with 4px gap, more control in column 31; overflow confined to marker strip.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Approved primary action with explicit hover, focus and disabled states.

components.name: Library Field
components.description: Readable white search field inside the library filter surface.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">搜索文献<input class="ds-field" placeholder="书名、作者"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label{display:grid;gap:6px;color:#535968;font:400 14px/1.7 system-ui,'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC',sans-serif}.ds-field{min-width:0;min-height:42px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--control-border,#d9dbe4);border-radius:7px;background:var(--white,#fff);color:var(--ink,#252831);font:400 16px/1.7 system-ui,'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC',sans-serif;caret-color:var(--blue,#4e54c8)}.ds-field::placeholder{color:#6b6f7c;opacity:1}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#4e54c8);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Current application location, using restrained fill and visible keyboard focus.

components.name: Integrated AI Composer
components.description: Text area and two closely stacked right-side actions share one frame.
components.css: .ds-composer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 56px;gap:8px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--control-border,#d9dbe4);border-radius:12px;background:#fafbfc}.ds-composer:focus-within{border-color:#888ed6}.ds-question{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:82px;max-height:200px;resize:none;border:0;outline:none;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#252831);padding:6px;font:400 16px/1.75 system-ui,'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC',sans-serif;caret-color:var(--blue,#4e54c8)}.ds-question::placeholder{color:#6b6f7c}.ds-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:2px}.ds-actions button{width:100%;min-height:38px;padding:5px 4px;border:1px solid var(--control-border,#d9dbe4);border-radius:6px;background:white;color:var(--ink,#252831);font:500 14px/1.7 system-ui,'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC',sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}.ds-actions .ds-ask{background:var(--blue,#4e54c8);border-color:var(--blue,#4e54c8);color:white}.ds-ask:hover{background:#2648bd;border-color:#2648bd}.ds-send:hover{background:#f4f5f9;border-color:#bfc3d2}.ds-actions button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue,#4e54c8);outline-offset:3px}.ds-actions button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:default}

narrative.overview: 用户确认的 canon 方向结合清晰内容排版、精确控件和文献组织秩序。白色正文、冷灰导航、炭黑文字与克制靛蓝适合持续阅读。内容以标题、留白、列表和细线组织，沿用 Axiom SVG 与 Morphicons，不新增栅格素材或功能。
keyCharacteristics: 用户与管理同一视觉语言

rules.name: The Content First Rule
rules.body: 颜色区分操作、状态与正文层次，阅读器静止边界不形成色带。

rules.name: The Readable Text Rule
rules.body: 不通过缩小正文和辅助文字换取密度。

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: 平坦内容默认，阴影限于已有认证与状态表达。

dos: Do maintain effective CSS tokens and regenerate the sidecar.
Do preserve readable body and helper text.
Do preserve continuous white reading, keyboard focus and reduced motion.
Do reuse Axiom SVG and existing Morphicons.
donts: Don't restore obsolete serif display typography or dark blue canvas.
Don't add paper shadows or permanent reader separator bands.
Don't change desktop drag geometry, default closed outline, 30-marker rows or the two right-side vertical actions.
Don't invent statistics, uploads, new applications or raster assets.
